messages:
maria (sales): Hey team — Forge AI POC asks for a 3-week Dedicated commit that mixes A100 + H100 GPUs and wants aggressive burst to on-demand during demo spikes. They're asking if we can discount burst from the standard premium. Can we offer a reduced burst rate for the POC capped at $5k?
kenji (solutions): Can you paste expected concurrency / token volumes? burst impact depends heavily on seq length and KV cache reuse.
maria (sales): Customer expects ~50 concurrent sessions, ~2k tokens per session per minute on average. Demo spikes hit ~200 qps for <10m windows. Target latency <150ms at 4k seq.
jonah (eng): Technically we support mixed pools but KV cache locality costs increase with heterogenous nodes. Burst to on-demand is fine, but cold starts for new nodes are ~20–30s. If we cap burst windows to 10m and enforce a token budget we can meet their latency SLO for the demo.
olivia (revops): For pricing context: our normal committed pool base rates + burst premium are in the ratecard. Standard burst multiplier = x3. For a short POC we can propose a special 'POC-burst' multiplier = x2 limited to a token-minute budget or a dollar cap, refundable against a conversion commit. Need formal deal-desk approval for an exception. :eyes:
olivia (revops): Proposed ratecard snippet for bookkeeping:
```
Committed A100: $1.20/hr per GPU
Committed H100: $1.75/hr per GPU
Standard burst multiplier: x3
POC proposal: burst multiplier x2 up to $5,000 cap (or 30k token-minutes), refundable if customer converts within 30 days
```
maria (sales): I like the refundable credit approach and the explicit cap. Customer wants it called out in the SOW that burst caps will be enforced and overages billed at standard burst rates.
kenji (solutions): Also recommend a short ops runbook: pre-warm policy tied to demo schedule, canary route 10% traffic to warmed pool for first 2 minutes, fallback to smaller variant model to preserve latency if burst quota exhausted. I can draft this.
deal-desk-bot: New pricing exception request created: REQ-2026-458. Link: https://gtd/deal/REQ-2026-458
olivia (revops): I'll raise REQ-2026-458 to finance + legal. Need a perf-risk ack from eng and a short SOW that sales can sign. Jonah — can you confirm perf risk is acceptable with the limits?
jonah (eng): Ack from eng. With the pre-warm + 10m cap + token budget it's acceptable. We'll include an automatic fallback to a lower-memory model variant to keep latency stable if needed.
maria (sales): Demo scheduled for Friday — can we fast-track approval this week?
olivia (revops): I'll escalate to deal-desk manager and finance. If legal asks for a 1-week addendum, we can sign it.
kenji (solutions): I'll start the runbook and a quick test plan for the pre-warm behavior (can replicate with internal staging).
maria (sales): Thanks all. @olivia please post updates here when REQ-2026-458 moves. :raised_hands:
olivia (revops): Will do — pinging finance and legal now.
